title: Fluid Mechanics / Hydrostatics

sections.heading: 1. Pascal's Law, Buoyancy & Floatation
sections.proseLatex: Pascal's law: pressure transmitted equally. Buoyant force $= V\rho g$ (Archimedes' principle).

keyFormulas.label: Buoyant Force
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Upward force equals weight of displaced fluid.

sections.heading: 2. Viscosity, Stokes' Law & Terminal Velocity
sections.proseLatex: Viscous force $= 6\pi\eta r v$. Terminal velocity: viscous force = net weight.

keyFormulas.label: Stokes' Law
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Viscous drag on a sphere at low Reynolds number.

workedExamples.problemLatex: Ball of radius $r$, density $\rho$ falls through height $h$ into water. Terminal velocity = entry velocity. Find $h$.

wbjeebTraps: Terminal velocity occurs when net force is zero.
Bernoulli's theorem applies to ideal, incompressible, streamline flow.
